mapper.select: select p.id id, p.seller_id sellerId, p.category_id categoryId, p.title title, p.price price, p.images images, p.description description, p.condition_level conditionLevel, p.is_flash_sale isFlashSale, p.flash_start_time flashStartTime, p.audit_status auditStatus, p.audit_note auditNote, p.status status, p.update_time updateTime, p.view_count viewCount, (select count(*) from favorite f where f.product_id = p.id) favoriteCount, c.category_name categoryName, u.nickname sellerNickname from product p left join category c on p.category_id = c.id left join user u on p.seller_id = u.id where p.id = #{id}

select p.id, p.title, p.images, p.price, p.condition_level conditionLevel, p.flash_start_time flashStartTime, p.status, u.nickname sellerName from product p left join user u on p.seller_id = u.id where p.is_flash_sale = 1 and p.audit_status = 1 and p.status in (0, 1) order by p.flash_start_time asc, p.id desc

select p.id productId, p.title, p.price, p.flash_start_time flashStartTime, p.status, u.nickname sellerNickname, (select count(*) from flash_sale_record r where r.product_id = p.id) participants, (select count(*) from flash_sale_record r where r.product_id = p.id and r.is_success = 1) grabbed from product p left join user u on p.seller_id = u.id where p.is_flash_sale = 1 order by p.status asc, p.flash_start_time asc, p.id desc
